{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders again after cleaning
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders after cleaning: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Now check the customer_age column again
print("\nDistribution of customer_age:")
print(sales['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())"}
